say: Joy sells wigs in Port Harcourt. Her cold ad set showed a Reel of a wig being installed to women in Rivers State interested in hair care. It brought 28 chats at about 375 naira each.
Her warm ad set retargeted people who engaged with her Instagram in the last 60 days, with prices and a WhatsApp button. It brought 42 chats at about 250 naira each, and more orders.
Do not target all of Nigeria if you only deliver in one city.
Uche runs a laundry service in Enugu. Ad A was a designed flyer with the words, quality laundry services, call now.

say: Here is the most important calculation in this module. Rukayat sells pepper soup packs in Lagos.

card.title: Does Rukayat's ad pay?
card.note: Naira figures are illustrative and approximate.

say: Each pack sells for about 6,500 naira. After ingredients, packaging and delivery she keeps about 2,500 naira. That is her break-even cost per order. Ads must cost less than this.

card.title: Does Rukayat's ad pay?
card.note: Naira figures are illustrative and approximate.

say: She spends about 2,000 naira a day for 7 days, 14,000 naira in total. The ad brings 40 conversations, so 350 naira each. From those chats she gets 10 orders, a conversion rate of 25 percent.

card.title: Does Rukayat's ad pay?
card.note: Naira figures are illustrative and approximate.

say: Cost per order is 14,000 divided by 10, which is 1,400 naira. That is below 2,500, so each order still leaves about 1,100 naira profit after ads. The ad pays.

say: Every week on the same day, record spend, conversations and orders from your WhatsApp labels.

panel.heading: Decide with a weekly log
items: Record spend, chats and orders weekly
Judge over a week, not a day
Above break-even: pause and fix creative
Below break-even: raise budget about 20%

say: New ads go through a learning phase, and small budgets can stay there. So avoid editing every day, and judge over a week.

say: Add your payment method only inside Meta billing, and set an account spending limit while you learn. Never send money or your login to someone offering to run your ads cheaply.
And follow the ad rules. Never claim a product cures a disease, and never use fake discounts or someone else's photos.

panel.heading: Protect your money and your name
items: Pay only inside Meta billing
Set an account spending limit
Give helpers their own access, not your password
No health claims; only claims you can prove

say: To remember. Boost posts that already work. Target where you deliver, and retarget warm people. Show the real product in use with one clear button. Keep cost per order below profit per order. And set a spending limit and make only honest claims.
